<description>
For a wtxid announcement of a transaction that is in the orphanage, `AddTxAnnouncement` computes the missing parents of the orphan (`GetUniqueParents`, then `AlreadyHaveTx` per parent) and then calls `MaybeAddOrphanResolutionCandidate`. That function returns without using the parents if the peer is already an announcer of the orphan. If the peer has no relay permission and `m_txrequest.Count(peer) + unique_parents.size() > MAX_PEER_TX_ANNOUNCEMENTS`, it returns after using only their count. In both cases the peer is not added as a candidate, and the same lookups run again for every `inv` message that lists the wtxid. #35878 deduplicates within one message only.

This PR does both checks before the parent lookups. The second check uses `vin.size()` in place of the number of missing parents.

**Behavior change:** `vin.size()` is an upper bound for the number of missing parents. A peer without relay permission is no longer added as a candidate when `Count(peer) + vin.size()` exceeds `MAX_PEER_TX_ANNOUNCEMENTS` but `Count(peer)` plus the number of missing parents does not. That needs inputs that share a parent, or parents that are already known.

**Measurement:** regtest, one node, RelWithDebInfo, base a527a0077a. The orphanage holds 12 orphans with 2430 inputs each. One peer, which delivered one of the 12 orphans and has sent at least 3600 announcements of unknown wtxids before, sends 300 `inv` messages that each list the 12 wtxids. Time per `inv` message:

| | per inv |
| --- | --- |
| master | 14.5 to 16.2 ms |
| announcer check only | 13.2 to 15.0 ms |
| this PR | 0.19 to 0.22 ms |
| control, 12 unknown wtxids per inv | 0.18 to 0.27 ms |

**Tests:** no new test. Passing locally: unit suites `txdownload_tests` and `orphanage_tests`; functional `p2p_orphan_handling.py`, `p2p_tx_download.py`, `p2p_opportunistic_1p1c.py`, `p2p_1p1c_network.py`, `p2p_invalid_tx.py`, `p2p_permissions.py`, `p2p_leak_tx.py`, `mempool_packages.py`. Not run: the rest of both suites, fuzz targets, lint.

Contributed by [turingpoint](https://www.turingpoint.de).
</description>

<commits>
b2f33e5298 p2p: skip parent lookups for orphan announcements that cannot add a candidate

When a peer announces the wtxid of a transaction in the orphanage,
AddTxAnnouncement computes the orphan's missing parents before
MaybeAddOrphanResolutionCandidate decides whether the peer can become
a resolution candidate. For an orphan with many inputs this means
thousands of lookups per announcement, and the result is discarded
when the peer is already an announcer or has no room left in its
announcement budget.

Do both checks first. The budget check uses the number of inputs as
an upper bound for the number of missing parents, so a peer close to
MAX_PEER_TX_ANNOUNCEMENTS may no longer be added as a candidate for
an orphan whose inputs share parents or whose parents are partly
known.

Signed-off-by: Jan Kahmen <jan@turingpoint.de>
</commits>
